scope: Exactly three new TDC public-test prediction families per task for Phase 0.75. This budget does not authorize a challenge evaluation or public-test-informed repair.
historical_disclosure: Phase 0.5 already evaluated these public-test labels. The Phase 0.75 test is not pristine. Every new complete prediction artifact therefore consumes its reserved family before scoring, and no result-driven replacement is allowed.

families.purpose: Exact MapLight plus GIN reproduction attempt
families.configuration_state: must be frozen after Gate 2 and before prediction

families.purpose: At most one final contender selected only from sealed shadow evidence
families.configuration_state: unselected; Gate 4 must freeze all seeds, columns, and metric counts before prediction
families.declared_seeds: pending Gate 4; no result-informed seed selection

family_consumption_rule.consumed_when: A complete finite row-aligned canonical prediction artifact exists for one task, even if it has not been scored.
family_consumption_rule.partial_task_rule: A complete valid task artifact consumes that task's slot. Remaining tasks may resume only from the identical frozen source, environment, and configuration. A completed task must not be regenerated.
family_consumption_rule.failed_infrastructure_rule: A run consumes no task slot only when it creates no complete task prediction artifact and accesses no Phase 0.75 public-test label. Record the failure and exact boundary.
family_consumption_rule.repeatability_rule: One pre-score repeat is permitted only from the identical frozen state, with public-test labels unavailable, to verify byte identity. A non-identical repeat stops the family and cannot be selected or averaged as a repair.
family_consumption_rule.scored_family_rule: After any task score is visible, make no code, environment, feature, preprocessing, estimator, seed, or averaging change within that family.

prediction_preflight: isolated environment and all dependency hashes frozen
complete configuration and declared seeds frozen
exact public-test task row identities and raw input hashes frozen
model-facing input contains no label or label-bearing provenance field
prediction process cannot resolve a measurement or score file
all rows are present once, ordered, finite, and receipt-bound
canonical and repeat prediction artifacts are byte-identical
independent review passes the applicable Gate 1, Gate 2, or Gate 4

scoring_boundary.future_paired_inference: A separate pre-result contract may authorize paired scaffold or family inference from already frozen comparator and contender predictions. It must count every metric evaluation and cannot generate or change predictions.
scoring_boundary.fixed_and_gin_exact_reproduction: For each task, score the five seed columns separately to reproduce the upstream seed-metric mean and population standard deviation. Score the predeclared arithmetic probability mean once as a separately labeled local ensemble comparator.
scoring_boundary.rounding: Retain full-precision AUPRC. Also reproduce PyTDC 1.1.15 behavior by rounding each seed AUPRC to three decimals before computing and rounding the five-value population mean and population standard deviation.

forbidden: prediction regeneration after a visible score
claiming the local probability-mean ensemble is the exact published statistic
using AUROC as the primary TDC CYP metric

forensic_gate.trigger: Any seed, ensemble, intermediate, or final AUPRC greater than or equal to 0.95
forensic_gate.action: Stop performance work and obtain an independent audit of raw and standardized duplicates, external and pretrained overlap, cross-isoform labels, grouping, row alignment, provenance fields, chronology, scaffold concentration, label polarity, and metric code before treating the value as evidence.
